events.affiliation: Republican; AOL reporting identifies Wiggins as a Republican candidate for Fayette County Commission, and Ballot Project and GoodParty.org candidate records list the 2026 District 9 Position 2 candidacy as Republican
events.event_type: arrest and criminal charge related to alleged campaign-sign theft
events.source_title: Oakland mayor arrested on scheme to steal campaign signs
events.subject_response: Wiggins declined to comment on his arrest. The reports state that he and the other two defendants were released on $2,500 bond.
events.summary: Oakland Mayor George Adrian Wiggins was arrested and charged with criminal conspiracy to commit theft of property under $1,000 after investigators alleged that he coordinated and paid others to remove rival campaign signs. Reporting also alleges that he told a participant to lie if questioned. The allegations have not been adjudicated, and Wiggins is presumed innocent.
events.reason_for_status: The current-window arrest and charge were reported by WMC/WSMV and a separate AOL report, with the latter expressly identifying Wiggins as Republican; Ballot Project and GoodParty.org records independently document the Republican candidacy. The subject response is preserved as a refusal to comment. This is recorded as a criminal charge, not a conviction or factual finding. Auto-publication is withheld because the directly accessible evidence is news reporting rather than an official charging or booking record, despite corroboration and the documented response.
